name: localgov_components-dev
description: NPM development scripts for the localgov_components module.
author: LocalGov contributors

scripts.lint: npm run prettier; npm run lint:css; npm run lint:js; npm run lint:twig; npm run phpcbf
scripts.phpcbf: which phpcbf && phpcbf --standard=Drupal,DrupalPractice --extensions=php,module,inc,install,test,profile,theme,info,txt,yml --ignore=node_modules,vendor . && npm run phpcs
scripts.ci: npm run prettier:check && eslint . && stylelint "**/*.css" && ../../../../../../vendor/bin/twig-cs-fixer check . && npm run phpcs
